For Pat's 10-mile endurance run, the music should feature a consistent, steady beat to help maintain a rhythmic pace and support a meditative state. Instrumental tracks with a moderate tempo (around 120-140 BPM) are ideal. Genres such as ambient electronic, minimal techno, or steady post-rock would work well, as they provide a driving but non-distracting rhythm that aligns with the sustained intensity of long-distance running.
